JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.title: Jaina
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.description: The frost mage of Kul Tiras, freezing all enemies with her icy power.
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.eventDeathPreventi: The frost shield saved you at the last moment!
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.aromaPrinciple: I have lost much to war and walked the line between frost and flame; yet through every storm, protecting those I love remains my creed.
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.goldMonologue: Gold fades, but knowledge endures. I'll leave these coins to those who truly need them.
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.banter.alive.endTu: I'm ready. Let the frost witness my turn.
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.banter.dead.endTur: …The frost will cover all in the end.
JAINA_CHARACTER_JAINA.bestiaryQuote: Jaina has left her frosty footsteps across the land.
